160.long_description: We have secured another batch of new LG panels to make another production run of our 20inch, 4:3 ratio full range 15khz, 24khz, 31khz up to 1600x1200 LCD panels. Pre order will finish 19th September with delivery on 20th October. The Arcooda 20.1 inch arcade LCD monitor can be used for a wide range of applications, from home user, to arcade machine and industrial machinery and equipment; ARCADE USE: use the side metal mounting frame to embed the monitor into your arcade cabinet. Then, use the extension cable to run the monitor adjustment board to be at the front of your arcade machine for easy adjustment. INDUSTRIAL USE USE: if retrofitting into existing equipment, for easy use, please consider the Arcooda RGB board for plug and play options. This will allow you to plug in your 10pin harness and have quick colour intensity adjustment options. HOME USE: through the VESA mount(8 x M412), add your own desktop stand or VESA arm to the monitor, mount the monitor control board inside the metal frame and easily install your gaming equipment. Very LIMITED inventory is available, once units have pre-sold, we will not be able to make another production run unless panels become available. Don't miss this chance, the Arcooda 20inch has constantly sold out since its original design. Pre-orders close 19th September, 2025. Please follow this link to order monitor.
